column3: Kuroneko Route · God's Trial
And so, work progressed smoothly.
If we stick to the schedule we'll be rather busy. But we should make it if we keep this pace up.
But the real accidents will probably start to happen at times like these...
No way...
What? What's wrong, Kuroneko?
At this time... How... could it be...
H-Hey... Kuroneko? What exactly happened?
...It seems that God loves to put me through trials.
The pen tab died.
...Huh?
Pen tab -- short for Pen Tablet.
To clarify, it's an indispensable tool used for drawing on the computer without the mouse but with a stylus. The shape resembles a real pen.
That's why, there's no way to continue drawing the manuscript like this.
Are you... serious?
D-Don't you have spares? You said you had ways to cope with trouble, right?
Even this is too unexpected. Moreover, buying a spare pen tablet for this was too costly...
In that case, how about we borrow... That's right, Saori should have one, right?
Impossible. While she does have a pen tablet, she left it as it is when it broke down.
When we went to Akihabara the other day to buy things, Saori specifically went to window-shop for a new one.
How about the clubroom!?
Impossible. A club member obsessed with BL has borrowed it.
Then how about buying a new one---
Then we're back to square one, I don't have the money. That day's train ticket was already cutting it close.
Participating in the event and printing materials seems to be costly as well.
If we take on a part time job... Wait, it's impossible at this time...
That's right, there isn't enough time left...
Under such circumstances, the best solution is...
In that case, I'll help with the money. We should be able to start work that way, right?
Although I'm not surprised that you would say that... That's a no.
Why? Isn't this the best solution to the problem? Unless there's other ways?
Who knows? I can't think of any right now. However, I don't wish to use this solution.
Like I said, why?
I've said it before. This is 'my' work. For that sake, that's why I can't use someone else's money, my pride won't allow it.
You're still saying this when we have already come this far!?
Of course I must. Don't you get it? This activity is purely a hobby. For this reason, if it's something I cannot accept, then there's no meaning to this.
That's why I won't borrow your money.
If all else fails, I'll sell things to raise the money. That's the value of this manuscript to me.
Damn it, what is she doing... doing whatever she pleases, she's just talking to herself over there...
...That's...
Eh?
...That's the same for me too!
...What? What are you referring to?
I'm saying, this piece of manuscript has the same value to me too.
...What are you saying? This manuscript is mine.
It's true that it's yours. It's something you have drawn, thus being your very own manuscript.
However, it's no longer 'just' yours.
What? Are you trying to say since you helped out, it has become yours too?
How shocking... Please know your place.
It's true that what I've done is merely a little. And it's something simple that anyone could do.
It's nothing compared to what you've done. Under such circumstances, I won't say things like "it's mine too".
However, I won't lose to you in wanting to complete this manuscript!
Good grief, people like you... So you plan to forcefully have your way again?
That's all I can do...
Certainly, I agree... That's all you have. Unfortunately, I have no intention of changing my mind.
Though... Yes. If you could answer this question of mine, I might consider it.
R-Really!?
Yes. Provided you can answer it, of course.
...No matter what it is, I will give you an answer.
I wonder?
That glance is saying, no lies allowed...
Why are you... going so far?
Aren't you preparing for exams? Are you supposed to be here doing this? Do you understand your own situation?
And yet, why... are you going so far for me?
What am I... to you?
I... never considered this...
No, I could NOT consider it.
Putting my relationship with Kuroneko into words... I never could express it properly, always postponing it...
And now I have to answer her...
I... Can I find a good answer?
No good...
I can't find it...
But Kuroneko is still waiting...
It's still too early to give up...
Let me calm down and think through it again...
I'm sure it exists?
There's no way it doesn't exist, right? Something that describes my relationship with Kuroneko...
That's right...
This answer, at least it won't be a mistake.
An important friend.
Not only Kirino... for me as well, you're an important friend that is irreplaceable.
Is that so, a friend...
So we're friends... that's right. I guess we do have that kind of relationship...
It feels like I'm making a mistake... or it's me that's in denial...
However, I feel that this is the best answer I could give.
...Like a little sister, I guess?
*sigh*
How much further do you want to insult me?
I think this is the best way of putting it... from what I can think of...
You're my kouhai.
As your senpai, I have to look after you, y'know?
You...
You're clinging to me based on that level of relationship?
For an untamed cat, there must be a master for her, right?
Guh...
Huh... I thought she'll reply with cold laughter immediately just like before...
...Kuroneko?
I see...
...I won't ask you, why you would choose to say that.
But you have already spoiled my mood... do you get it?
I thought you would be a person that is able to make a decision... no matter how stupid you are... how disappointing.
Keeping up appearances with your words, with no meaning to them... No, sometimes it'll become a sword that will destroy yourself, do remember this
with your body...
Kuroneko slapped me...?
Wait Kuroneko, I didn't have that intention...
The pain on my cheek, doesn't really have any feeling to it...
As compared to that, my heart hurts even more.
Kuroneko is crying. And I happen to see this. Not only that...
The person that made her cry... was me.
I thought of just making a dull joke and I didn't expect it to hurt her, it's all my fault...
...Don't you dare show your face to me again---
...Kuroneko left...
But I... don't have the right to chase after her.
Because, the one that made her cry, was me.
That's a question that can't be answered wrongly, and yet I did...
...Damn...
It looks like, I... have stepped onto a land mine...
To that question, I'm unable to give an answer...
